The closest match to “Ziaoddini music graph recommendation” is a paper by Kajwan Ziaoddini on socially aware music recommendation using a multi-modal graph neural network. It builds a heterogeneous graph with user-song interactions and user-user social relationships, and uses multi-modal representations from lyrics, audio, and visual data to produce socially contextualized recommendations, with emotion-aware embeddings contributing to emotionally aligned suggestions. [1]

None of the other supplied papers is directly by Ziaoddini or specifically a “music graph” approach in the same way; they instead focus on multimodal LLM-based recommendation, mood/emotion-conditioned ranking, or other recommendation architectures and inputs (e.g., mood signals, audio embeddings, conversational tool calling). [2,4,10]
